## Features

- First public release of InvoicePress, providing a desktop application and command-line tools for previewing, imposing, exporting, and printing invoice PDFs.
- Supports macOS and Windows on both x64 and ARM64 processors.

## Fixes

- No user-reported fixes are included in this initial release.

## Other Changes

- Release assets are published for darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, win32-x64, and win32-arm64.
